title: skills(objectstack-data) + docs(rls): teach "the person is a record" — a membership key with `valueField: 'id'` yields the caller's own roster rows (#31129 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eHDXrsKgGAUHq956U

Filing gate: ④ coordination — the docs-and-skill half of the maintainer's ruling 6708428544 on #31129 (letter A, 「同意」), whose execution names it: "`domain:skills` then adds the "the person is a record" example to the data skill and the RLS guide." ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:skills` — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` (+ its eval `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`) and `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`, after PR #31174 merges.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "membership key valueField id skill" → 17 hits; none teaches `valueField: 'id'` (#25234 designed the keys, #26423 named them in the guide's context-variables section).
Business reason: HR, service-desk and portal apps model the person as a row (`employee`, `agent`, `customer`). Once PR #31174 lands, an author can declare `my_employee_ids` with `userField: 'user'`, `valueField: 'id'` and write `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids`. Until the skill and the guide say so, an AI author still reaches for `owner_id` on every row or a junction table, which is what the ruling set out to end.
Blocked-by: #31129

## Owed

1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`: in the membership-key section, add the "the person is a record" example (roster `employee` with `userField: 'user'`, `valueField: 'id'`; a `leave_request` policy `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids`), and say what it does not do: it grants nothing by itself, and comparing the set with another object's column is still refused. Add or extend an eval prompt in `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` that exercises it.
2. `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`: the same example beside the existing membership-key text.

Wording source: the merged `packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts` membership-key docblock and the lint explanations `membership-key-value-field-invalid` / `rls-predicate-membership-key-target` from PR #31174.

**Level:** docs and skill text; Tier H if `skills/**` is governed at landing (the dev checks `check-governed-merges`). Full Fable review per the maintainer's standing skills rule.

Related: #31129, PR #31174, #25234.
